runs.name: ION Geophysical Corporation; formerly NYSE IO, OTC Expert Market IOGPQ, seismic data acquisition and processing services and products in two segments, E&P Technology & Services and Operations Optimization, with a 49% INOVA interest written to zero in 2014, SEC CIK 0000866609; named Input/Output, Inc. until 2007-09; the 9.125% notes due 2021-12-15 not paid by election; Chapter 11 filed 2022-04-12 in the Southern District of Texas; NYSE suspension 2022-05-18; assets auctioned 2022-06-29, part to TGS; the First Amended Plan effective 2022-09-12 cancelling the common interests; registration revoked 2023-11-13 (Release No. 98904); no 10-K for 2021 and nothing filed since; CGG, Schlumberger and Geospace read as the filing rivals, TGS, PGS, Shearwater, Polarcus and BGP flagged
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price: **no usable quote** (OTC Expert Market from 2022-05-18; the aggregator route returns HTTP 404; the SEC's revocation opinion deems true that the stock was not publicly quoted or traded as of 2023-05-08). Shares: 29,617,040 on the last cover (10-Q to 2021-09-30, acc 0001437749-21-025105), by hand, `Screens/cover_shares.py` refused the name; **none today**, the common interests "cancelled, released, and extinguished" under the First Amended Joint Chapter 11 Plan effective 2022-09-12 (FINRA UPC#28-22, quoting the plan, secondary; the confirmation order, docket no. 660 of Case 22-30987, read through the RECAP mirror, flagged). Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-15). Filings read: FY2020 10-K, 0001437749-21-002669; FY2017 10-K, 0000866609-18-000006; 10-Q to 2021-09-30; the 8-Ks of 2021-12 to 2022-07 including the RSA, plan and disclosure statement (0001437749-22-008791); NT 10-K 0001437749-22-007933; Release No. 98904. One figure cross-checked: 2020 revenue $122,674 thousand against XBRL $122.7M. The brief departed in one stated place: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2020 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (four chosen, the fourth the Chapter 11 record). **Q1 IN** (the position understood with certainty from the plan and the court record: a cancelled interest in a dissolved estate; TOO HARD (NATURE) and OUT at Q1 argued and rejected in the framework notes). **Q2 OUT**: the castle shown open on the evidence, no operating profit in any year 2014 to 2020 (margins -4.4% to -45.4%), operating income about -$206M on about $3,109M of revenue 2011 to 2020, E&P Technology & Services deciding at about 71% of the positive five-year segment sum, support and other larger than either segment's profit; CGG -55.1% to -20.0% 2015 to 2017 (20-F, nothing filed after FY2017), Geospace -89.4% to 1.1%, Schlumberger 10.2% to 18.4% (whole company, flagged); the operating assets sold to others in 2022, part to TGS. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** the 2021 note payment missed by election; no 2021 10-K and a revocation by default after two SEC orders went unanswered; the WesternGeco patent loss, an injunction and a $20.8M damages payment in 2016; "as adjusted" figures featured beside GAAP in the FY2017 report. Facts beneath the stop: equity $425M to -$73M and the deficit -$424M to -$1,012M 2011 to 2020; cash held flat by revolver draws and share issues, the count doubled in 2021; debt $105M to $220M throughout. Owner cash by hand from the filed cash-flow statements (`tools/run.py` misses the multi-client library investment, $14.9M to $28.8M a year): 2016 to 2020 average **-$13.28M equity-only, +$0.17M all-equity**. COMPUTATION on the filed record (net debt $109.683M at 2021-09-30, leases left out): value about **-$3.70 to -$3.60** a share all-equity (-$8.26 equity-only, no-growth case alone), fair about **-$3.67 all-equity** (-$4.48 equity-only), against no usable quote; no positive price earns the floor; not armed, the box being OUT at Q2 and the share's claim nil on the plan's terms. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session-context commit subjects naming the ENYN run and fold (a bankrupt filer closed TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1) and the CTBG fold, and the memory index lines; none used; no blind-listed file opened, listed or searched. Commits 48c3e094, dd7c07dd, 8118554c, 417ec71f. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for IOGPQ, IO or ION Geophysical). Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's `verify_cites.py` 28 ids, no phantom, no E-id, 17 quoted fragments, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** (1) the framework has no route for a security cancelled under a confirmed plan or revoked with nothing filed since; this run chose Q1 IN then Q2 OUT, where CTBG and ENYN today closed TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1, so three bankrupt or dark filers in one night were boxed two ways; a one-line rule is a PRIME RULE 5 decision; (2) the reporting figures have no defined form for a share that no longer exists; (3) `tools/run.py` does not read multi-client library investment as capital spending and cannot resolve a delisted filer by CIK. Could not get: the amended plan's own text, the entered confirmation order, the auction proceeds; the court's case website did not render.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: the castle shown open on the evidence, no operating profit in any year 2014 to 2020 (margins -4.4% to -45.4%), the field's filing seismic rivals CGG and Geospace losing money too, the operating assets auctioned in 2022 with part going to TGS, and the common interests cancelled under the First Amended Plan effective 2022-09-12; registration revoked 2023-11-13. Q1 IN, the position understood with certainty from the plan. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 2021 note payment missed by election, no 2021 10-K, a revocation by default, the WesternGeco patent loss. COMPUTATION on the filed record: value about -$3.70 to -$3.60 a share all-equity, fair about -$3.67 all-equity (-$4.48 equity-only), no usable quote; not armed. Framework gap for the operator: no route for a cancelled or revoked security, and three such filers tonight boxed two ways (CTBG and ENYN TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1, IOGPQ OUT at Q2).
